title: auth.module.activated v1
description: A module was activated (or reactivated) for a tenant: by an operator (POST /api/v1/tenants/{id}/modules), by creating a tenant on a plan, or by a plan change that (re)activates it. Emitted by svc-auth through the transactional outbox (app/services/module_lifecycle_events.py) in the SAME commit as the write that caused it, and published by EventOutboxRelayWorker as {"message": json.dumps(payload)} on stream alebrije:events:auth (at least once). ADR-115 Addendum D6: it is a NUDGE, not the state — a consumer re-reads the roster GET /api/v1/internal/modules/{module_id}/tenants (the single source) before acting, so a late, repeated or reordered event converges to the truth, and keeps its own periodic reconciler for an event that never arrives. FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape), with schema_version, like auth.dsr.erasure_approved.

event_id.description: UUID4 of this event, equal to auth.event_outbox.event_id (UNIQUE there). Consumer-side dedup key.

event_type.description: Canonical event type. Consumers route on this exact value.

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose module state changed (shared.tenants.id). The consumer re-checks THIS tenant against the roster.

module_id.description: Module whose activation changed (shared.modules.id, e.g. 'paperclip'). A consumer ignores events for modules it does not run.

activo.description: The new value of shared.tenant_modules.activo for this row.

context_id.description: Sucursal (shared.contexts.id) when the row is a per-context override (ADR-115 §2.1); null for the tenant-wide baseline.
